title: SOAS English-Uzbek RAG Evaluation (Retrieval-Only)
description: Auxiliary metadata for a 400-row English-Uzbek retrieval-only pilot benchmark. The public release excludes gold_answer, reference_answer, answer, context, excerpt, and source-text fields while full QA release clearance is pending. Documented quality flags are not yet exhaustive.

planned_full_qa_release.note: Answer/reference fields are excluded from the public release until source-derived text is manually cleared.

limitations: Pilot benchmark with template-generated questions, domain mismatches, and uneven item quality.
The quality_flag field is useful but not exhaustive; unflagged does not necessarily mean manually validated.
Retrieval-only pilot release; not a full generated-answer quality benchmark.
Does not support answer correctness, faithfulness, or reference-answer metrics without separately cleared references.
Full raw corpora, indexes, and HPC run artifacts are not included in this release folder.
English supplementation results are retracted and should not be cited.
citation: Tripathi, Rajan Prasad (2026). SOAS English-Uzbek RAG Evaluation (Retrieval-Only), manual_eval_v5. Zenodo. https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.21067667
